license_required.quote: it is unlawful for an individual to practice or attempt to practice podiatry or to claim to be licensed as a podiatrist without first obtaining a license to practice podiatry

age_minimum.quote: Is at least 18 years of age

degree_required.value: Doctor of Podiatric Medicine (D.P.M.) from accredited college of podiatric medicine
degree_required.quote: Has received a certificate of graduation from an accredited college of podiatric medicine, recognized by the Council of Education of the American Podiatry Association or its successor or other organization approved by the board

accrediting_body.value: Council of Education of the American Podiatry Association or successor or other organization approved by the board
accrediting_body.quote: recognized by the Council of Education of the American Podiatry Association or its successor or other organization approved by the board

required.quote: An applicant who has graduated after January 1, 1991 from podiatric medical school as set forth in section 3651‑C seeking licensure to practice podiatry shall provide the board with evidence of satisfactory completion of at least one year of postgraduate clinical training in a podiatric residency training program

duration.quote: at least one year of postgraduate clinical training in a podiatric residency training program

kind.quote: podiatric residency training program approved by the accrediting body of the American Podiatric Medical Association, or its successor or other organization approved by the board

exams.name: Board-approved examination
exams.quote: an individual must pass an examination approved by the board before engaging in the practice of podiatry

interval_years.quote: A doctor of podiatric medicine licensed to practice podiatric medicine and surgery within this State shall apply on or before July 1st of every year

required.quote: On or before July 1st of every year, an applicant who is practicing podiatric medicine and surgery in this State shall include satisfactory evidence to the board that in the preceding license period the applicant has completed a program of continuing education as prescribed in the rules of the board

value: 3 hours of continuing education every 2 years on the prescription of opioid medication
topical_requirements.quote: an individual licensed under this chapter must successfully complete 3 hours of continuing education every 2 years on the prescription of opioid medication as a condition of prescribing opioid medication

available.quote: The board may issue a license to practice podiatry by endorsement to an applicant who has successfully passed the written examination of another state or of a national certifying agency in podiatry recognized by the board

requirements.value: Applicant must have passed written examination of another state or national certifying agency equivalent to Maine's examination and satisfy all other requirements for licensure including postgraduate clinical training requirement
requirements.quote: if the written examination of the other state or national certifying agency was equivalent to its own examination and if the applicant satisfies in all other respects the requirements for licensure in section 3651‑A

national_certification.quote: podiatric residency training program approved by the accrediting body of the American Podiatric Medical Association, or its successor or other organization approved by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misuse of alcohol, drugs or other substances that has resulted or may result in performing services in a manner that endangers patient health or safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misuse of alcohol, drugs or other substances that has resulted or may result in the applicant or licensee performing services in a manner that endangers the health or safety of the licensee's patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional diagnosis of a mental or physical condition that has resulted or may result in performing services in a manner that endangers patient health or safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A professional diagnosis of a mental or physical condition that has resulted or may result in the applicant or licensee performing services in a manner that endangers the health or safety of the podiatrist's patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in false, misleading or deceptive advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in false, misleading or deceptive advertising

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing narcotic or hypnotic or other controlled substances for other than accepted therapeutic purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing narcotic or hypnotic or other drugs listed as controlled substances by the federal Drug Enforcement Administration for other than accepted therapeutic purposes

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with the requirements of the Controlled Substances Prescription Monitoring Program
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the requirements of Title 22, section 7253

definition_quote.value: the diagnosis and treatment of maladies of the human foot and ankle by medical, surgical or mechanical means
definition_quote.quote: Practice of podiatric medicine means the diagnosis and treatment of maladies of the human foot and ankle by medical, surgical or mechanical means

methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosis and treatment of maladies of the human foot and ankle by medical, surgical or mechanical means

drug_authority.value: A licensed podiatrist may prescribe narcotic drugs for the treatment of ailments within the scope of the podiatrist's license with the approval of the Drug Enforcement Administration
drug_authority.quote: A licensed podiatrist may prescribe narcotic drugs for the treatment of ailments within the scope of the podiatrist's license with the approval of the Drug Enforcement Administration

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: the diagnosis and treatment of maladies of the human foot and ankle by medical, surgical or mechanical means

anesthesia_authority.quote: Practice of podiatric medicine includes the administration of local anesthesia in conjunction with the practice of podiatry. The use of general anesthesia is permitted in conjunction with the practice of podiatry when administered or supervised by a medical or osteopathic physician

podiatric_assistant_authorized.quote: This chapter may not be construed to prohibit a podiatrist from delegating to a podiatric assistant certain activities relating to medical care and treatment that are delegated by custom and usage, as long as those activities are under the supervision or control of the podiatrist

podiatric_assistant_supervision_level.quote: those activities are under the supervision or control of the podiatrist, who must be present on the premises at the time the activities are performed

telehealth_authorized.quote: A person licensed under this chapter may provide telehealth services as long as the licensee acts within the scope of practice of the licensee's license

opioid_prescribing_rules_required.quote: an individual licensed under this chapter and whose scope of practice includes prescribing opioid medication may not prescribe

controlled_substances_prescribing_ce_req.quote: an individual licensed under this chapter must successfully complete 3 hours of continuing education every 2 years on the prescription of opioid medication as a condition of prescribing opioid medication

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: to the sale of nonprescription foot appliances in commercial establishments

impaired_practitioner_program.quote: The board may establish protocols for the operation of a professional review committee as defined in Title 24, section 2502, subsection 4‑A. ... The board has the power to contract with other agencies, individuals, firms or associations for the conduct and operation of a podiatrist health program operated by a professional review committee.

electronic_prescribing_required.quote: An individual licensed under this chapter and whose scope of practice includes prescribing opioid medication with the capability to electronically prescribe shall prescribe all opioid medication electronically by July 1, 2017

preoperative_history_and_physical_author.quote: Practice of podiatric medicine includes the performance of a history and physical on a podiatrist's preoperative patient and upon the patient's admission into a hospital or ambulatory surgical center
